name: Treasury, ALM & Interest-Rate Risk in the Banking Book
description: Balance-sheet interest-rate risk, funds transfer pricing, and net interest income sensitivity.

metrics.name: nii_sensitivity
metrics.description: Change in 12-month net interest income under a rate scenario

metrics.name: eve_sensitivity
metrics.description: Change in economic value of equity under a rate scenario

metrics.name: repricing_gap
metrics.description: Assets minus liabilities repricing in a bucket

conventions.rule: Every sensitivity names its scenario, horizon, and balance-sheet assumption (static or dynamic).
Non-maturity deposit and prepayment assumptions drive results; state them.
Sensitivities add across balance-sheet lines within one scenario, never across scenarios.

caveats.text: IRRBB outputs are assumption-driven model results, not observed values.

chart_conventions.rule: Show repricing gaps as bars by bucket in maturity order, positive and negative around zero.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
